/.title: Jamin Galea — Product Designer
/.description: A London-based, product designer with over 15 years experience in the design industry. Founder of booksabout.food
p: Jamin Galea
A London-based digital product designer. Currently, Product Design Lead at Popsa focussed on memory-curation features on our native apps.

I’ve spent the last 15 years designing web and native apps, across multiple industries. I’m most at home in the ambiguous, complicated ones, where a clear idea has to survive real constraints and still look great.
I started out in agencies, where I learned to carry a project comfortably from start to finish, long before “0 to 1” was a phrase.
I’ve always believed that craft is the foundation, not the finishing touch. Now more than ever. Failing fast is no longer a good strategy.
Growing up in Malta taught me to be pragmatic and ambitious at the same time, and it’s probably why I’ve always built projects on the side.

AI tools have changed how I work. My technical ability has grown and I can now build things I couldn’t have built alone. Going from sketch to working product quickly has raised my ceiling and given me a layer of polish and control I didn’t have before. The 101 ideas I’ve jotted down over the years are finally getting somewhere.
Below is a selection of my most recent work.
Popsa — Web App
Popsa is an AI-powered platform helping millions of users curate, preserve and relive their memories through beautifully curated memories and printed photo products.

I was entrusted with starting Popsa’s web team. I helped plan, design and launch their first progressive web app in under 9 months. 12% of the revenue and 20% of new accounts now come from this platform. And basket-to-order conversion consistently exceeds the native apps by an average of 9.8% (Q2 ‘24-Q4 ‘25).
Case study coming soon
Arrival — CareHub
Arrival was an electric vehicle startup reimagining how vehicles are designed and manufactured. CareHub served as the central hub for all the information related to the vehicles and the business.

It was a comprehensive resource covering everything from financing and procurement to diagnostics and repairs. As it was accessible from every touchpoint, I focused heavily on creating a clear, intuitive content hierarchy. I scoped, planned and designed a year’s worth of features within 2 months, structured for release over 4 phases.
Menu Menu

An app designed for the hospitality industry that bridges the gap between chefs writing menus and ops teams publishing them. In simple terms, it's a content management and design solution for creating and managing beautifully designed F&B menus in real time.
Books About Food

Passionate about food and tech, I founded Books About Food; a curated platform showcasing beautifully-designed cookbooks alongside 3,500+ automatically-generated portfolios of the people that make them come to life.
Updated daily and with 5,500+ pageviews each month, the platform has started to change the way publishing teams operate and commission the design of cookbooks.
Featured on Creative Boom and Headnotes. Also on Instagram.
Self Initiated
Soho House — House Pay
Soho House is a members club with more than 40 houses around the World.

'House Pay' was a first principles approach to a new payment system built into the members' app and integrated with a complex in-house POS systems. The new interface enhanced the members' experience and started the journey towards better data science for the business. It was also designed to improve the member experience, streamline operations and reduce fraudulent activities.
Case study available on request
Arrival — Fleet Simulator
The fleet simulator allowed teams to remotely diagnose, monitor and manage virtual fleets through an interactive map and timeline.

While physical vehicles were still in production, the simulator provided realistic data across 200+ telemetry points, enabling teams to model real-world scenarios, test and iterate on code, validate internal procedures and build confidence in how the vehicles would behave once deployed.
Other highlights
SomeOne in London
Set-up and grew the digital arm of one of London's most awarded design agencies with a new agency-model-friendly digital design and development process.
Brand Cloudlines

Developed ahead of market and backed by an initial investment of £250K, I led the scoping, design and build of a SaaS tool for creating and sharing digital brand guidelines. The product was built for one of London’s most awarded design agencies and remains white-labelled and in use today across multiple industries.
UK Parliament
Designed a nationwide role-playing ‘boardgame’ named Election Toolkit in a box; teaching students aged 8-18 in 2,000+ schools how democracy works and why voting matters.
Wall of Wally

An illustrated tribute to the late branding expert Wally Olins. 200+ illustrators from around the world contributed their interpretation of Wally’s most iconic portrait photo which culminated in an exhibition of the work in Shoreditch, London.
Design Studio Directory
A curated list of a 1000+ design studios organised by location helping graduates and others looking for creative studios from around the world. This project is now run by Studio Noel.
